article.title: Warrant with whom to be lodged
article.content: When the prisoner is to be confined in a jail, the warrant shall be lodged with the jailor.
article.html:
460Warrant with whom to be lodged

Section 460 · Chapter XXXIV · Imprisonment

When the prisoner is to be confined in a jail, the warrant shall be lodged with the jailor.
